# TierBadge

Figma: [08l. TierBadge](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-964) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The deal-level tag & tier-badge system - small pills that overlay a deal card to signal its guarantee tier, qualified-investor eligibility, ROI, and status. Reused by CardDeal and HeaderCard. (08l - TierBadge.)

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/tier-badge/reference.png`

### dealTags

Deal image overlay pill (Deal_Tags, the TierBadge): guarantee tier «مضمونة برهن», qualified-only «فرصة حصرية للمؤهلين», ROI plus tenor, and «مغلقة بنجاح» closed status.

Level: atom · Part of: CardDeal, Base card

Use when:
- On CardDeal and Base card deal images, one or two per deal
- Type=pros on light surfaces

Don't use when:
- For deal status in lists use StatusPill
- For neutral labels use Tag

Accessibility: Overlay variants need a dark image behind white text for contrast.

Compliance: Guarantee and ROI tags are claims: show only when the deal's offering documents back them; ROI is projected.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Deal_Tags is a single component with a Type variant covering four badge families: guarantee tier, qualified-investor, ROI, and status. Each is a compact pill designed to sit on top of a deal image.

Most variants use a translucent dark fill with white text so they read over photography - previews below sit on a dark surface for that reason.

### Anatomy

A rounded pill containing a label and, for most types, a small icon (stamp / qualified-investor seal).

### Parts

- Pill - rounded container; translucent dark (overlay) or light fill by type.
- Label - the tag copy (e.g. “مضمونة برهن”, “حصريًا للمؤهلين”).
- Icon - stamp (guarantee) or qualified-investor seal; omitted on status/ROI text-only.

### Types

Eight Type variants across four families:

### Guarantee tier - Premium · Basic · pros

“مضمونة برهن” (mortgage-guaranteed) + stamp. Premium = brand border, Basic = tertiary border, pros = light fill.

### Qualified-investor - Type7 · Type8

“فرصة حصرية للمؤهلين” (exclusive for qualified investors) + seal icon. Type8 mirrors icon/label order.

### ROI - RIO/Black · RIO/White

Return + tenor (“6 أشهر · 7.55%”). Black = solid tertiary; White = light card + qualified seal.

### Status - Closed

“مغلقة بنجاح” (closed successfully) - muted/disabled fill for settled deals.

### Code examples

```typescript
<DealTags type="premium" />           // guarantee tier
<DealTags type="qualified" />          // Type7 - exclusive for qualified
<DealTags type="roi" tenor="6م" rate="7.55%" />
<DealTags type="closed" />             // settled
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Place overlay tags on the deal image - the dark scrim gives white text its contrast.

Do

One or two tags per deal - a tier + an eligibility marker reads cleanly.

Don’t

Don’t stack four tags on one card - it turns the hero into clutter.

Don’t

Don’t put white-text overlay tags on a light surface - the label disappears. Use “pros” for light contexts.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Deal_Tags is the final, shared component (used by CardDeal & HeaderCard) - documented, not rebuilt. Change it in one place.

> **Tip:** Type7 vs Type8 differ only in icon/label order; RIO/Black vs RIO/White differ by surface (on-photo vs on-card).

> **Warning:** Most variants are overlay-only (white text on a translucent scrim) - they need a dark image behind them; on light backgrounds use “pros”.
